name: OpenCode
summary: Register Diffusion Router as an OpenCode provider with your Diffusion API key.
statusNote: This guide registers Diffusion Router directly using OpenCode’s provider configuration and your Diffusion API key.
prerequisites: A Diffusion Router API key from API keys.

setup.title: Merge the Diffusion provider
setup.body: Preserve existing providers and plugins; this block is additive.

setup.title: Export your Diffusion key
setup.body: Add the export to your shell profile and open a new terminal.

restart: Restart OpenCode so the merged configuration and provider plugin load.

verification.title: Discover models through Diffusion
verification.body: The catalog lists the native upstream model IDs as served by Diffusion.

troubleshooting: 401/403: check the key and tenant binding in API keys.
Provider missing after restart: confirm the JSON merged cleanly (no trailing commas, valid JSON).
Empty catalog: Diffusion reports discovery state on the Connect page; retry when it is fresh.

removal.title: Remove the Diffusion blocks
removal.body: Delete both the provider and models blocks you merged and unset the key. Revoke the key in API keys if unused.

rollback: Restart OpenCode; other providers and plugins are untouched.
